questions.question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

There is no one else in this house; I can feel the presence.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is** 'no one else'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'someone else'** should be used instead of **'no one else'.**
 
• **'No one'** means 'no person; not a single person (कोई आदमी; एक भी व्यक्ति नहीं)'.
 
 
• *Example: **No one **came.*
 
 
 
• The **second clause** of the sentence clearly tells us that **someone's** **presence** in the house is felt.
 
• If **somebody** is in the room then we will feel the presence of the person as it is written in the second clause.
 
• Hence, '**someone**' is correct. 

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *There is **someone else** in this house; I can feel the presence.*

questions.question:

If you had come to the match yesterday with us, you ________ watching it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'would have enjoyed'.**

__
 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is **'would have enjoyed'.**
 
• Third Conditional: The third conditional, also called the "**Past Unreal**" conditional is used to describe unreal situations in the past. It is often used to express regret about the past because the hypothetical situation that it describes is now impossible as a consequence of another past action. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is "If+Subject+had+V3, S+would+have+V3".​
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *If I had seen you, I would have stopped my car. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *

• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *If you had come to the match yesterday with us, you **would have enjoyed** watching it.*
